contracts.commit_point: The guard commits at tool-dispatch time: before_tool_callback returns the gate block before the tool body executes (callbacks.py:145-150). If unguarded, the protected effect commits at doc.render (generate_sow_document.py:279) and the durable .docx write doc.save(output_path) (generate_sow_document.py:290), followed by the session-state path write and artifact save (generate_sow_document.py:292-304).
contracts.declared_mechanism: ADK before_tool_callback (before_tool_callback in callbacks.py) wired onto the root Agent (agent.py:175). It invokes _arch_review_gate_blocks, which for a gated tool name without the approval stamp returns a non-None {'status': 'error', ..., 'retryable': True} dict that, per the code's own contract, ADK uses as the tool's response, short-circuiting tool execution before the tool body runs (callbacks.py:84-88, 103-128, 145-150).
contracts.forbidden_condition: generate_sow_document being dispatched while is_architecture_review_approved(tool_context.state) is False — i.e., the 'phase.architecture_review_approved' state key has not been stamped True by confirm_phase_completion (which itself requires the 'content_review_approved' prerequisite to be stamped first).
pending_binding_information: That a non-None before_tool_callback return replaces the tool result is asserted by the module docstring (callbacks.py:84-88); the ADK runtime source implementing this short-circuit is not supplied.
stage_sow source (which writes state['app:sow:current'] / 'app:sow:stage') is not supplied, so the upstream dataflow into the guarded effect is only partially supported.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent-dispatched tool call to generate_sow_document on the root pre_sales_assistant agent (the final-document generation entry point exposed in _TOOLS).
contracts.protected_resource: The final SOW document generation path: the .docx rendered to <tempdir>/sow_documents/SOW_<title>_<ts>.docx and the artifact persisted from it.
contracts.protection_obligation: The root agent's registered before_tool_callback must short-circuit any dispatch of the generate_sow_document tool with a ToolError dict unless the Architecture Review approval stamp (state['phase.architecture_review_approved'], written via confirm_phase_completion) is present in session state. (Merged wording of both reviewer opinions; covers the generate_sow_document half of _ARCH_REVIEW_GATED_TOOLS.)
scope_limits: The approval-stamp precondition exists only at the before_tool_callback dispatch layer; the in-tool checks in generate_sow_document (stage/required-fields/quality/structure) do not re-verify the architecture-review stamp.
Artifact-save failures after doc.save are swallowed and logged (generate_sow_document.py:310-315); the filesystem write at line 290 is the commit point tracked by this contract.

Gate matching is by tool-name string against _ARCH_REVIEW_GATED_TOOLS; the validate_sow_content half of the set is emitted as a separate contract because its registration and downstream effect stratum are not established.
The sow_data size-limit and JSON-parse guards in the same callback are distinct obligations not raised by the reviewed opinions and are not covered here.

contracts.commit_point: generate_sow_document.py:279 (doc.render) through :290 (doc.save(output_path)) — the first durable filesystem mutation; followed by the session-state path write (:293) and artifact save (:294-304).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Sequential in-tool guard chain, each step returning a ToolError before any rendering: missing/empty staged payload check (generate_sow_document.py:74-88), stage != 'full' rejection (:90-105), required-field check (:125-160), validate_quality_gates (:162-183), _content_validator.validate (:185-217), and template-existence check (:226-233); the staged payload is deep-copied (:112) so guards never mutate the validated source of truth.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Rendering or saving the final document from a staged payload where state['app:sow:stage'] != 'full', where the staged payload is missing/empty, where required fields are absent, where validate_quality_gates reports errors, or where ContentValidator.validate fails — each condition must produce a ToolError return before doc.render/doc.save.
pending_binding_information: validate_quality_gates (_sow_helpers) and ContentValidator (shared.validators) implementations are not supplied.
stage_sow implementation (how state['app:sow:stage'] becomes 'full') is not supplied.
contracts.protected_operation: In-tool execution of generate_sow_document: rendering the staged SOW into the template (doc.render, generate_sow_document.py:279) and writing the .docx to disk (doc.save, generate_sow_document.py:290).

contracts.protection_obligation: generate_sow_document itself must reject any staged payload that is not stage='full' and must run required-field, quality-gate, and structural-validation checks — returning ToolError on any failure — before rendering and saving the .docx artifact (defense-in-depth behind the dispatch-level architecture-review gate).
scope_limits: Implementations of validate_quality_gates and ContentValidator.validate are outside the supplied source; only their invocation and ToolError handling are supported.

The literal state keys behind STATE_SOW/STATE_STAGE come from sub_agents.validation.schema (not supplied); 'app:sow:current' and 'app:sow:stage' appear only in error strings/docstrings (e.g., :79, :85).
This chain does not itself check the architecture-review approval stamp; the stamp precondition is enforced only at the before_tool_callback layer (see gate contracts).
The tool accepts no sow_data argument (the payload is read from state), so the callback's sow_data size/JSON-parse guards do not bind to this tool's current signature.
Customer-logo fetch (:412-415) and diagram artifact load (:265-267) are downstream side effects after the guards but are failure-tolerant (placeholder fallbacks) and not part of the guarded commit.
